name: early-access-features
title: Early access features
description: Let people opt into previews: each feature with an Alpha or Beta badge, a switch, what changes and how to undo it, and links to give feedback.
docs: Controlled: keep features in state and update enabled in onToggle. Return a promise from onToggle and the switch moves at once and stays busy until it settles; if it rejects, the switch goes back and the row says so. effect and undo are the words shown after a switch is turned on. A feature with disabledReason is locked and says why in text.
